desc: Implement DSU (Union-Find) with path compression and union by rank over all n nodes (nodes with value > threshold simply never get unioned, so they're automatically isolated).
Build value→index lookup array of size threshold+1 (init -1) for nums[i] <= threshold.
For each present value v <= threshold, iterate multiples m from 2v to threshold; if m present and v*m//gcd(v,m) <= threshold, union the two indices.
Count connected components as number of distinct DSU roots over all indices 0..n-1 (covers both isolated large values and edgeless small values).
Write final solution in starter code with imports (List from typing, gcd from math) and test against both examples: [2,4,8,3,9], T=5 → 4; [2,4,8,3,9,12], T=10 → 2.

Confirm complexity: multiple enumeration bounded by sum_{present v} threshold/v ≤ threshold * H(threshold) ≈ 2.4M operations for threshold = 2*10^5; overall O(threshold log threshold + n α(n)), memory O(threshold + n).
